title: Hajitek Majitek - Folktales from Morocco
author: Dar Lilei
description: Welcome to Hajitek Majitek — Folktales from Morocco! This family friendly podcast brings Morocco’s rich storytelling tradition to life with magical tales of courage, wisdom, and humor. Created and narrated by the founder of Dar Lilei, a Moroccan mother raising her kids in the UK. Each episode draws on the stories she grew up hearing from her own mother and grandfather. About brave heroes, clumsy animals, and mischievous ogres. Stories are told in English, French, and Darija so kids can pick up new words and enjoy the melody of their language. Enjoy the tales and let the storytelling begin!
